parameters.content:
## 02 Enrich & qualify
Per lead: deterministic enrichment (free-mail flag, MX record via DNS-over-HTTPS, optional website title) → rule engine (rules are rows in the database) → only unresolved leads go to the LLM → the answer is validated against a closed schema and thresholds → decision is written through set_decision() (human > rule > ai) → qualified leads go to 03. A schedule re-checks leads left undecided (e.g. the model was down).

parameters.query: select id as lead_id from leads where decision is null and created_at < now() - interval '2 minutes' order by id limit 20
select l.*, (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(r), '[]'::jsonb) from rules r where r.enabled) as rules from leads l where l.id = $1
update leads set is_free_mail = $2, mx_valid = $3, website_title = $4, enriched_at = now() where id = $1 returning id
select * from set_decision($1, $2, 'rule', $3, null, $4, null, null, $5)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Enrich & apply rules').first().json.lead_id, $('Enrich & apply rules').first().json.rule.decision, $('Enrich & apply rules').first().json.rule.score, $('Enrich & apply rules').first().json.rule.reason, $('Enrich & apply rules').first().json.rule.id] }}

parameters.query: insert into lead_events (lead_id, event, actor, details) values ($1, 'ai_called', 'ai', $2::jsonb) returning id

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Config').first().json.llm_model, temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a B2B lead qualification analyst. Given one inbound lead as JSON, answer with ONLY a JSON object with these keys: fit_score (number 0-1: how well the lead matches the ICP), segment (exactly one of: saas, agency, ecommerce, services, other), confidence (number 0-1: how sure you are given the available data; be low when title or message are missing), reason (one sentence, max 300 characters, cite the concrete signals), opener (one personalized first line for an outreach email, max 300 characters, no placeholders, no exclamation marks). No markdown, no extra keys." + ' ICP: ' + $('Config').first().json.icp }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($('Enrich & apply rules').first().json.lead_for_ai) } ] }) }}

parameters.query: select * from set_decision($1, 'review', 'ai', null, null, $2, null, null, null)
